messages:
tara: saw canary rollback for v3.2.0; tenants A/C evicted. unclear if rollout pin or kernel change.

ben: current rollout manifest only has model_ref+tag. we need variant-level fields.

li: propose optional keys: binary_variant, quant_mode, kernel_profile, max_seq, schema_version. keep all optional.

frank: add deploy snapshot ints: observed_peak_rss_mb, kv_cache_mb. lightweight.

ben: add diagnostic_vector (enum list) with values like resource_pressure, model_quality, client_seq_skew.

tara: rollback should set rollback_initiator and blame_override to avoid auto-reapply.

li: include telemetry_anchor_id to join logs. analytics will treat missing as unknown.

audit-bot: deploy-log: canary 2026-06-02T11:02:04Z model=v3.1.9->v3.2.0 traffic=10% status=partial_rollback at 2026-06-02T11:13:25Z (trigger=eviction-spike)
